correctness.rationale: For K_{s,t} and one vacant vertex the macrostate is (vacancy part A/B, i=#red in A). Moving within same part preserves an agent's occupied cross-part neighbor multiset, hence own closed-neighborhood same-color ratio and payoff. Every improving move flips vacancy side along one of edges A_i-B_i (blue) or A_i-B_(i+1) (red), an undirected path. The moving color has identical pre/post payoff arguments in reverse on the same edge, so edge orientation cannot reverse; no repeated macrostate or directed cycle. At most b+1 possible counts of blue in A on either vacancy side implies at most 2b+2 macrostate vertices and 2b+1 jumps. Two-vacancy K3,3 witness has four strictly improving jumps returning the same labelled placement with tent peak 9/20 and exact improvements 0→20/33, 20/27→10/11 twice. Fresh own exact-rational simulation checked all four positions, ratios and the final labeled state; no global computational census asserted.
